text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Culture and Information Minister Hamed Youssef Hummadi says in a news conference in Rabat, Morocco, that Iraq has honoured all its disarmament commitments under the 1991 Gulf War ceasefire.
- Hummadi says Iraq is ready to open a new chapter with Kuwait and Saudi Arabia.
- Sudanese army repels attack from Eriterea.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives Libyan diplomats in Baghdad
- (The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Trade ministry pumps more spare parts to markets.
- Commentary attacks U.S. State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns for delay in arrival of humanitarian supplies to Iraq under oil-for-food deal.
- Article on ways to increase agricultural production.
- Chinese officials visiting Baghdad say China backs Iraq in fight against U.N. trade sanctions.
- Article on role of private sector in developing Iraq's economy.
- Modern lighting techniques have been added to the gilded domes of Shi'ite shrines in Kerbala.
- National Assembly discusses ways of preserving rivers and water-covered areas against pollution.
